verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents automations (Release Pipelines, Scheduled Flags) and governance controls for flag changes: four-eyes Change Requests, audit logs that retrace flag values, and kill switches. None of these is documented as versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automation definitions themselves. These are adjacent controls on flag state, not on the automations, so they earn no credit under the partial-credit boundary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
